description.value: Pho Hong on Fraser is a family-operated Vietnamese restaurant that has anchored its South Vancouver neighbourhood since 1998, built on a signature pho broth slow-cooked for 24 hours using AA-AAA Canadian beef. The menu spans pho variations, bún bò Huế, grilled-meat rice and noodle bowls, fresh salad rolls, and takeout-only bánh mì with all fillings made in-house. It is a well-established local spot with a loyal following and a broad menu that accommodates omnivores and vegans alike.
